newsitem.title: CHINA: China says probing seizure of Vietnam boats.
newsitem.headline: China says probing seizure of Vietnam boats.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it was still looking into reports that two Vietnamese patrols boats were seized by a Chinese vessel in the Gulf of Tonkin in mid-December.
"The Chinese government attaches extreme importance to this case," a Foreign Ministry spokesman told Reuters.
"Chinese departments responsible are handling this," the spokesman said. He declined further comment.
The Vietnamese Foreign Ministry said last month both vessels and their crews were missing.
Vietnam's Lao Dong newspaper said the two vessels, on anti-smuggling patrol, had discovered and stopped a boat suspected of illegally shipping goods to China off Vietnam's northern islands of Co To.
While crew members of both patrol boats were making checks aboard the boat suspected of smuggling, an armed ship approached and opened fire, the newspaper said.
Lao Dong said the ship then took the two patrol boats and 14 people who were aboard into custody. Two other crew members escaped on a lifeboat and returned to the Vietnamese mainland.
